mapper.insert: insert into user (openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar})
mapper.select:
select ifnull(count(case when date(create_time) >= #{begin} then id end), 0) as dayNewUser, ifnull(count(*), 0) as dayTotalUser from employee
and DATE(create_time) <= #{end}
